title: Triage All Defects
summary: Michelle triaged currently known launch defects from production probes, ops evidence, and unmerged engineering PRs. Each open item has severity (critical / high / medium / low), owner, reproduction status, and a release requirement. Formal Testing rows 176–187 remain Not Started, so this is the complete triage of currently known defects, not a claim that every possible testing-derived defect has been collected. Row 188 is not Complete. Founder acceptance is not recorded.

taxonomy.source: ops/fab-5/operating-system.json incidentSeverity + ops/fab-5/ROW-151-LAUNCH-DASHBOARD.md error severity + August Launch row 189

critical.meaning: Launch unavailable on the canonical public URL; payment broadly failing; material security/privacy; widespread access failure; material data-loss risk; severe participant-impacting production failure.
critical.row_189_class: blockers, payment/access failures, data loss, security

high.meaning: Material degradation of important functionality or a meaningful participant cohort, including broken Journey progression, Lumina safety failures, and mobile failures that prevent use.
high.row_189_class: broken Journey, Lumina safety, mobile failures

medium.meaning: Contained defect with a workaround; no material launch threat.

scope.michelle_did: Classify, assign owner, confirm reproduction where possible without mutating production, set release requirement, and hand Row 189 the register.
michelle_did_not: Fix defects (that is August Launch row 189, Imani primary)
Change Stripe, Cloudflare DNS, Vercel custom-domain, or nameservers
scope.reproduction_method: Read-only production HTTP/DNS probes from this workstation plus code inspection of current main. No charges, no DNS edits, no secret printing, no live participant accounts created.

testing_rows_not_started.deliverable: Run Data Integrity and Recovery Testing
Run Performance, Capacity and Load Testing

coverage.coverage_rule: Defects discovered by rows 176–187 MUST be ingested into this register before Row 189 can be treated as having a complete input set. Absence of a mobile/browser/a11y/security-review packet is a coverage gap, not proof those areas are clean.
